title: IBM Security Verify Directory 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and IBM Verify Directory 11.0.0 accepts GET requests for…
description: IBM Security Verify Directory versions 10.0.0 through 10.0.4 and 11.0.0 accept authentication credentials via HTTP GET requests, allowing passwords to be passed as URL parameters. This behavior exposes sensitive credentials in browser history and server logs, increasing the risk of credential leakage.
